verdict.rationale: Crossmint's Agent Checkouts take a product URL and a spending cap and complete the purchase. The evidence never shows an API or feed that exposes machine-readable offer data such as price, availability, variants or checkout links for listed products. The llms.txt probe covers documentation, not product offers, and no OpenAPI spec was found. A commerce-payments platform could plausibly ship offer data, so the axis applies and the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read machine-readable offer data — price, availability, variants, checkout links — for any listed product or service
